'''2007 New Jersey State Championship Tim Simon LS Dagobah: Yoda's Hut''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tim Simon]] at [[2007 New Jersey State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah: Yoda's Hut|Dagobah-L-dagobahyodashut.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I'm Sorry (not v)
* '''Username:''' aylets
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
